description: This file defines feature availability and limits for the Notesnook project, including functions to check feature access based on user subscription plans, and manages feature configurations and limits.

methods.name: isFeatureAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is available for the current user plan, returning details including allowance and errors.

methods.name: getFeatureLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the feature limit based on the user's current subscription plan.

methods.name: areFeaturesAvailable
methods.description: Checks multiple features' availability for the current user plan.

methods.name: getUserPlan
methods.description: Fetches the current user's subscription plan from the database.

methods.name: availableOn
methods.description: Determines which subscription plan a feature is available on based on limits.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the feature configuration object by its ID.

methods.name: planToAvailability
methods.description: Maps a subscription plan to its corresponding feature availability key.

methods.name: getFeaturesTable
methods.description: Returns a table of all features with their limits across different plans.

methods.name: getFeaturesUsage
methods.description: Provides usage statistics for all features based on current user plan.
